notes: ☀ Starter is now a Today page — the app has already done the work before you open it. Four cards fill themselves in, no buttons to press: ☀ a one-paragraph morning brief (which way the market is leaning, what this month is usually like, what the robot did overnight); 🤖 the robot's practice money ($50,000 → today's value, its latest trades in plain words); 💡 one idea today (the single strongest pick, in plain English, with what that signal has typically made per $100 — the full list stays one tap away); and ⭐ your shares, which only appears when something you watch actually moved. A new ⚙ Automation card replaces the jargon: the practice robot with a clear ON/OFF, and three tested styles — 🛡 Steady, ⚖ Balanced, ⚡ Bold — each described by its own ten-year record in one sentence. And the big one: the practice robot now starts ON for brand-new accounts (practice money only — the app cannot touch real money — with the OFF switch right there on the card). Existing accounts keep their exact settings. All the studies, reports and full evidence live one tap away in Advanced, unchanged.
